Now correctly isolates district-level-only target records. drillChart now SKIPS Ward (populationCoverageRankingBarchartByAPICCD) and points directly to Health Facility (populationCoverageRankingBarchartByLocalityICCD), since this campaign has no ward-level facilities. Ward chart left orphaned/unlinked, not deleted.

populationCoverageRankingBarchartByAPICC._comment: FIXED: filterKeys was 'healthFacility' (copy-paste mismatch) - this chart actually aggregates on ward.keyword, now filterKeys correctly says 'ward'. Target query already had correct must_not:HEALTHFACILITY.

populationCoverageRankingBarchartByLocal._comment: FIXED: drillChart was 'none', now correctly points to populationCoverageRankingBarchartByVillageICCD (the true deepest level, which was previously orphaned/unreachable). This chart's own terms field (HEALTHFACILITY) and filterKeys (healthFacility) were already internally consistent, just chart's display name says 'Locality' which doesn't match what it actually aggregates on - left as-is since renaming the chart ID risks breaking other references.

populationCoverageRankingBarchartByVilla._comment: STANDARDIZED: replaced the original bespoke Target calculation (targetPerDay-based bucket_script annualizing by x365, plus a custom computedFields postAggregationTheory mechanism unique to this chart) with the same simple sum(Data.overallTarget) + action:percentage pattern used by every sibling level. This chart is now the correct terminal end of the Province->District->Ward->HealthFacility->Locality/Village chain (previously orphaned/unreachable via drillChart). FLAG: if the original targetPerDay*365 logic was intentional (e.g. a different definition of 'target' specific to locality-level daily distribution targets), this change removes it - restore from original if that calculation was deliberate rather than a leftover/experimental artifact. No must_not needed here since locality is confirmed the deepest boundary level in this hierarchy (nothing below it to exclude).
